Elena (support): Heads-up: planning a maintenance advisory for Redwood Dedicated runtime. Change window proposed: 2026-04-02 22:00–23:15 UTC (UTC). Hosted API unaffected. Need status page + targeted emails. PTAL.

Elena (support): DRAFT SUBJECT: Redwood Dedicated maintenance advisory — Apr 2
Elena (support): Short summary: We will perform a kernel + runtime update on Dedicated pools on 2026-04-02 22:00–23:15 UTC. Some requests routed to Dedicated may briefly fail or see latency spikes while nodes are recycled. Typical disruption is short (under a few minutes).

Alex Kim: Suggest noting SDK retry guidance and linking our retry/backoff doc. Swap wording to "brief request failures" rather than "5xx" so it covers throttles/timeouts too.

Priya Shah: Add model-pinning guidance: pinned model versions => minimal impact. If you use 'latest' alias, we may temporarily route to the last compatible variant. If a customer needs a pin for their Dedicated pool for this window, forward to CS and we'll coordinate.

Jordan (eng-oncall): Ops rollout proposal: canary 15m -> 30% for 15m -> 70% for 20m -> full ramp if smoke checks pass. Recommend adding a 20m rollback contingency on top of the window. Rollback target: runtime v2025-11 (stable). Revert should be fast but could add 15–25m.

Maya (runtime): I'll confirm smoke checks and add the exact health metrics (QPS success ratio, median latency, GPU memory pressure) for the internal CS macro. Also verifying that model-variant routing TTLs won't cause prolonged routing churn.

Elena (support): Good. I'll keep the published change window as 22:00–23:15 and add a line: "window may be extended by up to 20 minutes in the unlikely event of rollback."

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: id=deploy-20260402-02 target=dedicated-runtime canary=2026-04-02T22:00Z ramp-plan=15m->30%->15m->70%->20m full rollback-plan=runtime-v2025-11

Elena (support): Status page snippet (for review):
```
Summary: "Planned maintenance — Redwood Dedicated inference pools"
Details: "On 2026-04-02 from 22:00 to 23:15 UTC we will apply a kernel and inference runtime update to Redwood Dedicated GPU pools. Some Dedicated requests may experience brief request failures or transient latency spikes while nodes restart. Hosted API endpoints and non-dedicated customers are not expected to be impacted. We will post live updates below during the window."
Impact: ["Brief request failures and transient latency (typically under a few minutes)", "If you use the 'latest' alias you may see temporary fallback to a compatible variant", "Autoscaled workloads should rely on SDK retries — see retry guidance"]
Mitigation: ["Staged canary with automatic rollback plan", "Option to pin model versions for Dedicated pools; contact CS to request pins"]
Contact: "cs@redwood.ai | status.redwood.com"
```

Priya Shah: Please include SLA link and add an internal CS runbook pointer (support macro) so agents can pre-fill rollback tickets and copy the smoke metrics.

legal: quick read: don't promise SLA credits in the public notice. Point customers to the SLA page and ask them to contact CS for claims.

Elena (support): Updated the draft: removed credit language, added SLA link placeholder. Plan to publish status update + targeted email on 2026-03-30 15:00 PT unless objections.

Alex Kim: I'll draft the support macro and email template. Suggested subject lines: "Redwood Dedicated — planned maintenance Apr 2 (brief potential interruptions)" or "Notice: Dedicated runtime update — Apr 2"

Elena (support): Draft outbound email body (support macro) — PTAL:
"Hi <customer>,
We will perform scheduled maintenance on your Redwood Dedicated capacity on 2026-04-02 from 22:00 to 23:15 UTC. During this window you may observe brief request failures or short latency spikes as nodes restart during a kernel/runtime update. If you have pinned a model version you should see minimal disruption; users of the 'latest' alias may temporarily route to a compatible variant. If you need strict SLAs for this window, reply to coordinate. For SLA details see <SLA link> and contact cs@redwood.ai. Live updates: status.redwood.com"

Jordan (eng-oncall): I'll cover escalation during the window; Maya is backup. We'll post runtime health metrics to the oncall channel and keep this thread updated.

ops-bot: Will publish deployment start/finish and canary health posts to this thread at runtime.

Elena (support): Final action list:
- Jordan/Maya: finalize rollback runbook and smoke-check thresholds
- Alex: support macro + outbound email template
- Priya: verify pinning blurb and SLA link
- Ops: ensure deploy-bot posts live updates here

Elena (support): Publishing plan: status page + targeted emails on 2026-03-30 15:00 PT. Please flag urgent edits by EOD today.

Alex Kim: LGTM.
Jordan (eng-oncall): 👍
deploy-bot: deploy-20260402-02 scheduled and will post updates in-thread.
